title: Vanishing Level-One Fourier Weight
statement: Let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\mathbb{R}$ take only the values $0$ and $1$, and suppose its uniform mean on the Boolean cube is zero. Then its Fourier weight at level one is zero.
hypotheses_covered: The uniform mean of $f$ is zero
